name: Illustrated
line: A warm editorial explainer in Bricolage Grotesque and Atkinson Hyperlegible with three flat illustrations drawn in SVG for the page, whose parts pop in as they arrive: a magnifying glass over a web of linked dots, two boxes of very different size wearing the same 'Group 1' tag, and a shield with a check for Code Against Cancer on a navy band.
notes: The box sizes are a metaphor for 'very different size', not drawn to scale; the figures sit beside them in text. Illustrations carry a faint print grain and use only the five palette colours and their tints. Atkinson Hyperlegible draws zero with a slash, so the few numbers inside body text are set in Bricolage. Both families are Latin-only; Chinese and Cyrillic fall back to system fonts. Without JavaScript or with reduced motion the illustrations are shown complete.
